reason: As a frugal two-person practice, paying ₹12,990 upfront makes no sense when article clerks rotate every two to three years and training them on complex software feels like wasted effort. Even though the flat pricing and WhatsApp forwarding are appealing, in a normal week I would stick to my morning routine and only test the free pilot to see if trainees can actually use it without my guidance.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time unless the blueprints and workflows genuinely require zero onboarding.
would_change_my_mind: Proof on the free pilot that a fresh article clerk can follow the statutory checklists and forward WhatsApp files with zero training or handholding from me.
